name: Hutton Hall
summary: Hutton in the Forest is a Grade I listed country house near the village of Skelton in the historic county of Cumberland, which now forms part of the modern county of Cumbria, England. It belonged to the Fletcher-Vane family from 1605 until 1931, when it became the property of the Barons Inglewood who were distant relatives of the Fletcher-Vane family.
